title: A pip becomes a seedling
question: Does this read as a pip settling in, sprouting, and growing -- not just a colour change?
context_md:
Round 28's own garden loop, closing: the delivered pip was dying the same tick it was set down because `deliver_seed_passenger` never re-armed the organism's Germinate schedule -- the ordinary seed-relocation recovery in `organism_tick` silently dropped it (the organism owns zero cells while riding as a passenger, so the recovery that finds a *relocated* seed has nothing to find). Fixed with the same `schedule_active_site` call `bear_seed_at` already uses.

With the schedule re-armed, `pip_checks` (round 28's own diagnostic) went from 0 on every seed to 213 and 241 on the two seeds with deliveries -- and among those checks, `resting` and `light` are never the blocker (100% pass both), `soil_water` is: only 2 of 454 checks ever read enough water against herb's 0.15 threshold. This organism (id 4656, seed=2) is one of the 2 that did.

Ringed cell is the delivery site (347,157), rolled to (347,161) before resting. Frame 0 is 18 frames before delivery; delivery is frame 45348; germination (1 cell -> 2, `GrowingTip` + `RootTip`) is frame 45356; by frames 45539-46339 it stands at 5 cells.
